# Hospital for Special Surgery (HSS)

> > America's #1 ranked orthopedic and rheumatology hospital, providing specialized care in musculoskeletal health, sports medicine, and advanced surgical treatments.

Hospital for Special Surgery (HSS) is a world-renowned academic medical center located in New York City, with locations across NY, NJ, CT, and FL. The hospital specializes in orthopedics, rheumatology, limb lengthening, sports performance, and advanced practice care, consistently ranked #1 by U.S. News & World Report.

## Key Topics

- Orthopedics
- Rheumatology
- Limb lengthening and reconstruction
- Sports medicine and performance
- Pitching analysis and biomechanics
- Advanced practice providers (PAs, NPs, CRNAs)
- Inflammatory arthritis treatment
- Critical care and anesthesiology
- Motion capture technology (DARI)
- Taylor Spatial Frame technique
- Osteoarthritis management
- Sarcoidosis care
- Healthcare careers and professional development
- Global health programs

## About HSS

- [HSS | Hospital for Special Surgery | #1 for Orthopedics](https://www.hss.edu): Top-ranked orthopedic & rheumatology hospital in NY, NJ, CT, FL
- [Why and How We Chose the Five Factors of Reliability | HSS](https://www.hss.edu/about/reliability-comparison/why-five-factors-of-reliability): HSS methodology for measuring hospital quality using 5 reliability factors
- [Hospital for Special Surgery Medical Staff by Department](https://www.hss.edu/about/hss-medical-staff): Complete directory of HSS medical staff organized by department

## Rheumatology & Arthritis Care

- [Inflammatory Arthritis Center | HSS Rheumatology](https://www.hss.edu/departments/medicine/rheumatology/inflammatory-arthritis-center): HSS center for rheumatoid, psoriatic arthritis & ankylosing spondylitis
- [Osteoarthritis Program](https://www.hss.edu/departments/medicine/osteoarthritis-program): HSS program for knee osteoarthritis integrating lifestyle medicine approach
- [Sarcoidosis Collaborative](https://www.hss.edu/departments/medicine/rheumatology/sarcoidosis-collaborative): HSS multidisciplinary team for sarcoidosis patient care and support

## Sports Performance & Analysis

- [Pitching Analysis | HSS Performance and Wellness](https://www.hss.edu/departments/performance-and-wellness/pitching-analysis): Baseball pitching biomechanics analysis using DARI motion capture tech
- [BOD POD Body Composition Scan in NYC | HSS](https://www.hss.edu/departments/performance-and-wellness/bod-pod): BOD POD body composition testing at HSS Tisch Sports Performance Center

## Anesthesiology & Critical Care

- [Orthopedic Special Care Unit (OSCU)](https://www.hss.edu/departments/anesthesiology/orthopedic-special-care-unit-oscu): Critical care unit for complex post-surgical orthopedic patients at HSS
- [Global Health Programs](https://www.hss.edu/departments/anesthesiology/global-health-programs): HSS anesthesiology global health initiatives and fellowship programs

## Nursing & Advanced Practice

- [Advanced Practice Providers: PAs, NPs, CRNAs](https://www.hss.edu/departments/nursing/advanced-practice-providers): HSS advanced practice providers: physician assistants, NPs, and CRNAs
- [Nurse Anesthetists - HSS Careers](https://www.hss.edu/careers/advanced-practice-and-allied-health/nurse-anesthetists): CRNA career opportunities and professional development at HSS

## Careers at HSS

- [Find Your Next Career at Hospital for Special Surgery | HSS](https://www.hss.edu/careers): Healthcare career opportunities at top-ranked orthopedic hospital HSS

## Limb Lengthening Patient Cases

- [Patient Case History: Renee](https://www.hss.edu/departments/limb-lengthening/patient-cases/llcase61): Renee's tibial osteotomy for Blount's disease using Taylor spatial frame
- [Patient Case History: Rosa](https://www.hss.edu/departments/limb-lengthening/patient-cases/llcase10): Rosa's Ilizarov hip reconstruction and femur lengthening case by Rozbruch
- [Patient Case History: Brenda](https://www.hss.edu/departments/limb-lengthening/patient-cases/llcase28): Brenda's bowleg correction using Taylor Spatial Frame technique
